# Maicon Lucinda

> Cloud Support Engineer, Security at AWS. Cloud security, network security, incident response, and threat detection. Based in Dublin, Ireland.

## About

Personal website of Maicon Lucinda, covering cloud security, network security, incident response, and hands-on security projects.

## Sections

- [Home](https://www.maiconlucinda.com/): About, expertise, and certifications.
- [Portfolio](https://www.maiconlucinda.com/portfolio/): Security and networking projects with code, descriptions, and demos.
- [Blog](https://www.maiconlucinda.com/blog/): Notes on cloud security, network security, and lessons learned on the job.

## Certifications

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
- CompTIA Security+
- Check Point Certified Security Expert (CCSE)
- Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA)
- Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator (PCNSA)
- F5 Certified Administrator, BIG-IP (101 & 201)
- Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
